name: Forlorn Crossing
summary: Forlorn Crossing is a lonely junction of paths nestled in northern Darkshore. Flanked by ancient ruins and shadowed coastlines, this road intersection serves as a transit point and staging ground for night elf defenders watching the wilderness.

sections.title: A Waystation in the Mist
sections.body: Situated between the haunted ruins of Bashal'Aran, the mist-choked Gloomtide Strand, and the encroaching forest wilds, Forlorn Crossing earns its grim name from the sorrowful atmosphere perpetual in Darkshore. As travelers and patrols journey between the coast and the inland groves, the intersection marks a rare clear waypoint amidst overgrown ancient lands.

sections.title: Defenders of the Wilds
sections.body: Because Darkshore faces corruption, aggressive wildlife, and ancient ghosts lingering in nearby ruins, vital path junctions require steady vigilance. Kaldorei Sentinels, archers, and allied druids frequently monitor such waypoints to maintain safe passage between night elven settlements and threatened ritual grounds.

faq.answer: Forlorn Crossing is an intersection of roads in Darkshore, located in the vicinity of the ancient ruins of Bashal'Aran and near routes leading toward the Gloomtide Strand.

faq.q: Why is it named Forlorn Crossing?
faq.answer: Like much of Darkshore, the region carries the weight of ancient tragedy dating back to the Great Sundering. Positioned near sorrowful ruins haunted by highborne spirits, the lonely road junction reflects the somber mood of the northern coast.

faq.q: Who guards or patrols Forlorn Crossing?
faq.answer: The area is watched over by night elven forces, including Sentinels, archers, huntresses, and druidic caretakers guarding against local threats and keeping travel routes viable.

faq.q: What nearby landmarks connect to this crossroads?
faq.answer: Paths from the crossroads connect travelers between the ruined settlement of Bashal'Aran, coastal shores like Gloomtide Strand, and nearby forest groves.

angles.text: Every path through Darkshore cuts across sacred ground scarred by the Sundering, making regular surveillance by Sentinels and druids essential to preserving balance.
Controlling and securing crossroad junctions ensures that Alliance supply lines and couriers can travel safely between northern coastal outposts.
